name: Honey Hotline
source:
Welcome to Honey Hotline ! An 18+ horror visual novel where you’re in a group project but ended up with a stalker on your tail. Now you have to find out about your stalker AND finish your group project !

[From [url=https://chuiipon.itch.io/bananaphone]Itch.io[/url]]
